name: Polaris Gold
oneLiner: pGOLD is Polaris's pre-launch synthetic gold CDP token minted against pETH collateral; tracks one troy ounce of gold with no physical backing or custodian.
collateral: Synthetic gold exposure minted through Polaris CDP infrastructure using pETH / ETH-derived collateral, with no physical gold reserve or custodian
pegMechanism: Pre-launch CDP-style pAsset: users are expected to post pETH collateral, borrow pGOLD debt that tracks one troy ounce of gold, and redeem or liquidate through Polaris protocol mechanics rather than issuer-managed bullion redemption
launchPhaseDetail: Public testnet now open on Sepolia (connect via app.testnet.polarisfinance.io; shared infrastructure with pUSD); security review and audit-preparation phase underway with professional audits upcoming; mainnet date uncommitted (issuer prioritising security over speed)

featuredContent.title: pGOLD: Finishing what DigixDAO started
featuredContent.description: A decentralized alternative to centralized gold stablecoins, offering trustless gold exposure backed by pETH collateral via CDP infrastructure.

featuredContent.title: CDPs Mint Dollars. Polaris Mints Anything
featuredContent.description: Polaris advances the CDP model with pETH collateral, autonomous interest rate mechanisms, and a multi-stablecoin factory framework.

featuredContent.title: The Path to the North Star
featuredContent.description: TokenBrice traces Polaris's origins from Robert Lauko's bonding-curve research to today's three-pillar mission: counterparty-free yield, ETH-correlated alternatives, and restoring DeFi credibility against a backdrop where only $184.79M of the $338.9B stablecoin supply is non-freezable.
